name: State Historical and Cultural Park “Ancient Merv”
description: Ancient Merv lies in the desert oasis near Mary in Turkmenistan, where a string of walled cities rose and fell over about 4,000 years along the Silk Road. In the 12th century it may have been the largest city on Earth, as capital of the Seljuk Empire. Today you can wander among its crumbling fortress walls, earthen ruins and surviving monuments across a vast plain.
